Ukuze wenze ibhethri lakho lihlale isikhathi eside, Ukonga Ibhethri Okuthuthukisiwe kumisa ama-app angabalulekile nezaziso zawo.\n\nUma ufuna i-app iqhubeke isebenza, yifake kokuthi \"Ama-app abalulekile\".
I-%1$s, engekho kuhlu lwe-app Ebalulekile, vula ukusebenza kokungamisi kancane i-app bese wengeza kuhlu lwe-app Ebalulekile
Thepha ukuze wandise impilo yebhethri ngokusebenzisa izihlelo zokusebenza ezilubalulekile kuphela

Uma udinga ukusebenzisa uhlelo lokusebenza amaminithi ambalwa, ungathepha uhlelo lokusebenza bese uliyekise ukuphumula.\n\nUngasetha nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezibalulekile ukuba zihlale zisebenza Kumasethingi.

Izinhlelo zokusebenza eziningi zizophunyuzwa futhi ngeke zibonise izaziso. Khetha izinhlelo zakho zokusebenza ezibalulekile ukuze ungaphuthelwa yizaziso ezibalulekile noma imilayezo. Ukuze ulondoloze ibhethri kakhulu, khetha izinhlelo zokusebenza ezibucayi kuphela.
Ungangeza izinhlelo zokusebenza eziningi kumasethingi Okonga Ibhethri Okuthuthukisiwe ngemuva kwesikhathi

Izinhlelo zokusebenza eziningi zizophunyuzwa. Usengakwazi ukwenza amakholi, ukuthola imilayezo yombhalo, nokuyeka ukuphumuza izinhlelo zokusebenza ozidingayo.\n\nIleveli yesilondolozi sakho sebhethri izoshintsha kusuka kokuzenzakalelayo kuya kokunamandla kakhulu. Ungashintsha lokhu kokuthi Amasethingi noma kunini.

Yandisa ibhethri lakho ngezikhathi ezibucayi uma udinga ukulenza lihlale isikhathi.\n\nUkonga Ibhethri Okuthuthukisiwe kukusiza uthuthukise impilo yebhethri ngokusebenzisa idivayisi yakho kancane. Siphinda sivule nezinye izici zamandla amakhulu. Uzothola isaziso sokusisebenzisa uma Ukonga ibhethri kuvuleka.
Thuthukisa impilo yebhethri ngokuqhubekayo ezikhathini ezibucayi ngokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezibalulekile nje kuphela
Ukonga Ibhethri Okuthuthukisiwe kuvala ezinye izakhi ezisebenzisa ibhethri eningi, njenge-Wi-Fi, i-hotspot, olunye uxhumo lenethiwekhi, ezinye izakhi ezifana ne-\"Ok Google\" nomsebenzi wangemuva.
Buza ukuthi sivulwa nini Isilondolozi Sebhethri

Nweba impilo yebhethri lakho ngokuqhubekayo ezikhathini ezibucayi. Ukonga Ibhethri Okuthuthukisiwe kuphumuze ama-app amaningi nezaziso. Khetha ama-app akho abalulekile ukuze ungaphuthelwa yizaziso ezibalulekile noma imilayezo.

Ukwandisa impilo yebhethri, Isilondolozi sebhethri:

 • Sivula itimu emnyama
 • Sivala noma sivimbela umsebenzi wangemuva, eminye imithelela yokubuka, nezinye izici
Ukugcina i-%s iphunyuziwe kunweba impilo yebhethri ledivayisi yakho. \n\nUngayiyekisa ukuphumula okwesikhashana noma usethe izinhlelo zokusebenza ezibalulekile ukuba zihlale zisebenza Kumasethingi.

Iphrofayela yakho yomsebenzi iphunyuziwe. Thepha ukuze uvule.
